dynamic/conveyor.right.mapping.encoding: Decoded bytes: across=R/255; along=(G*256+B)/65535; coverage=A/255; no premultiplication or color conversion

right.composition: Use static alone, or base + arrow/dynamic overlay. Optional surface + edge-glow + edge-core replaces base; never double-stack base and its components.
right.staticArrowPhaseSource: Shared animation phase: thresholded original atlas cell-0 intensity centroid at along=.5; no per-shape offset
right.phaseStatus: One unit per grid piece; normalized polar corner preview, not recovered live conveyor mapping

tintableLayers.blend: normal source-over; RGB=brightness*tintRGB; A=textureAlpha*layerOpacity; premultiply once
tintableLayers.frameSelection: Use the original clip phase formula and phaseSamples; select tintFrames[index] instead of frames[index].
tintableLayers.placement: Same cell, pivot, rotation and trim as the colored resource. Replace base/static with these layers; do not stack both.

parameters.source: ECS initialization/material values; not live runtime capture
parameters.clock: Shared route elapsed time; both independent effects continue across segment boundaries

textureProfile.coordinates: logical pixels; physicalRect and image dimensions are physical pixels
textureProfile.dataFilter: nearest packed height/flow coordinates; channel box continuous fields
